original.reason: The argument correctly identifies restricted conjugation as an automorphism of K, but it concludes that H is characteristic in G from invariance under inner automorphisms only; that conclusion is false in general. It also states only inclusion rather than the equality supplied by characteristicity, without explicitly deriving normality.

judgment.reason: It correctly uses normality of K to restrict conjugation to an automorphism of K, then characteristicity of H to obtain gHg^{-1}=H for every g.
Complete and correct proof of normality via conjugation automorphisms of K.
The map is well-defined and an automorphism by normality of K; characteristicity then gives the required conjugation equality.
It correctly establishes invariance of H under every conjugation by an element of G, exactly proving H is normal in G.
